top_findings: meta description had no fallback (homepage shipped none)
og:image rendered nothing when a page had no image
Organization JSON-LD url pointed at the current page, not the site root
no WebSite + SearchAction entity (no sitelinks search box)
twitter:site referenced an undefined setting; no sameAs signals
quick_wins: Publish the unpublished Oni Theory theme
Fill Social media & sharing settings (share image + profile URLs)
Set homepage meta description in Online Store > Preferences

findings.title: Missing meta description fallback
findings.description: <meta name=description> only rendered when page_description was set; homepage and description-less pages shipped no meta description.

findings.title: Imageless social cards
findings.description: og:image only rendered when page_image existed; homepage/collections/policies shared with no image.
findings.recommendation: Fallback page_image -> settings.share_image -> settings.logo; add twitter:image (applied).

findings.title: Organization url pointed at current page
findings.description: Organization.url was request.origin | append: page.url, changing per page and breaking entity consolidation.
findings.recommendation: Set url to site root request.origin; add sameAs (applied).

findings.title: No WebSite + SearchAction
findings.description: No sitelinks search box eligibility for brand queries.

findings.title: Brand entity signals incomplete
findings.description: sameAs empty until social URLs are entered in theme settings.
